user_query: Could you please give me the team schedule for a specific handball team? I'm interested in knowing the upcoming fixtures of the team in all the tournaments they are participating in.

获取该球队的所有比赛信息，包括赛事列表和比赛时间
筛选出即将到来的比赛（fixtures）
整理并展示球队即将参加的比赛安排
